user_question: Create a choropleth map of hospital counts across Centre County.

workflow_plan.goal: Create a choropleth map of hospital counts across Centre County.

workflow_steps.title: Dissolve county subdivisions into the Centre County boundary
workflow_steps.purpose: Create a single county boundary from the supplied county subdivision polygons for constraining the analysis area.
workflow_steps.instructions: Dissolve the county subdivision polygons into one Centre County boundary polygon.

workflow_steps.title: Clip census tracts to the county boundary
workflow_steps.purpose: Constrain the tract analysis zones to the supplied Centre County boundary.
workflow_steps.instructions: Clip the census tract polygons from input_2 using county_boundary as the clipping boundary.

workflow_steps.title: Count hospitals within each tract
workflow_steps.purpose: Compute the hospital count for every Centre County tract.
workflow_steps.instructions: Count the hospital point features from input_1 within each polygon in analysis_zones and write the result to a field named hospital_count.

workflow_steps.title: Create the hospital-count choropleth map
workflow_steps.purpose: Produce the requested interactive choropleth map of hospital counts across Centre County.
workflow_steps.instructions: Generate an interactive choropleth HTML map from counted_zones, classifying the polygons by the hospital_count field.
